profile.name: Dev Jain
profile.bio: React Native + Next.js engineer. I ship mobile and web products end-to-end — from idea to production.

points: Owned the development-to-deployment pipeline, implementing CI/CD and OTA updates with Maestro, EAS Workflows, and GitHub Actions — cutting internal testing cycles by 20% and shipping app updates without a Store submission for every iteration.

Migrated the app off the Ignite boilerplate to Expo Router, replacing a centralized navigator config with file-based routing bringing typed routes, automatic deep linking, and lazy bundling, and making navigation changes local to the files they affect instead of a single sprawling navigator.

Made the codebase agent-ready by authoring AGENTS.md and SKILLS.md encoding our coding conventions and Expo-specific patterns so AI coding agents produce work that matches house style, cutting review churn and token usage.

Built and shipped production AI agents with Hermes on Azure Container Apps, running real sales, marketing, product, and fundraising workflows — the app engagement and downloads rose ~4x (measured in Mixpanel).
Cut download size by 60% on iOS and 44% on Android — measured against actual App Store and Play Store download sizes before and after noticeably reducing install friction.
Implemented client-side feature flagging with Statsig, letting the team gate UI on time-boxed campaigns (e.g. World Cup-specific elements) and ship them without a new release.
Built the React Native frontend for the 'Planet Points' product launch — translated designs into a polished, production-ready mobile interface that shipped to pilot users.
Shipped the 'Receipt Scanning' feature end-to-end in a 2-week sprint, integrating camera-based OCR with backend reward APIs to take users from capture to reward in a single flow.
Audited legacy dependencies and unoptimized assets across the app, cutting bundle size by 100 MB — measurably faster builds and a lighter install for users on constrained devices and networks.
Built and maintained dynamic websites for clients using React and PHP, tailored to business-specific needs.
Delivered clean, responsive UIs with optimized performance across devices.
